answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to the temperatures at which food can be accepted upon delivery:

---

## 🌡️ Food Receiving Temperature Guidelines

### 🥶 Cold TCS (Time/Temperature Control for Safety) Foods
- **Cold TCS foods** (such as fish, meat, poultry, etc.) should be received at **41°F (5°C) or lower**, unless otherwise specified.

### 🔥 Hot TCS Foods
- **Hot TCS food** should be received at **135°F (57°C) or higher**.

### 🦪 Live Shellfish (Oysters, Mussels, Clams, Scallops)
- Receive at an **air temperature of 45°F (7°C)** and an **internal temperature no greater than 50°F (10°C)**. Once received, the shellfish must be cooled to **41°F (5°C) or lower**.

### 🦐 Shucked Shellfish
- Shucked shellfish should be received at **45°F (7°C) or lower**.

### 🥛 Milk
- Milk can be received at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C) or lower**, but should be refrigerated at or below **41°F (5°C)** upon receiving.

### 🥚 Shell Eggs
- Shell eggs should be received at an **air temperature of 45°F (7°C) or lower**.

### 🧊 Frozen Foods
- **Frozen food** should be **frozen solid** when received.
- Look for signs of thawing and refreezing, such as ice crystals in the box, fluids or water stains on the case, or frozen liquids on or in the packages.

---

## ⚠️ The Temperature Danger Zone
The **danger zone** is the temperature range where bacteria thrive: **41°F to 135°F**. Within this range, pathogens like Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria multiply rapidly — and can double in number every 20 minutes.

---

## ❌ When to Reject Food
If food temperatures do not meet requirements, or if TCS food shows evidence of previous temperature abuse, **do not accept the food**.

---

## 🌡️ Quick Reference Chart

| Food Type | Accepted Temperature |
|---|---|
| Cold TCS Foods (meat, poultry, fish) | 41°F (5°C) or lower |
| Hot TCS Foods | 135°F (57°C) or higher |
| Live Shellfish | Air: 45°F (7°C) / Internal: ≤50°F (10°C) |
| Shucked Shellfish | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Milk | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Shell Eggs | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Frozen Foods | Frozen solid (0°F / -18°C or below) |

Always use a **calibrated food thermometer** to verify temperatures at the time of delivery!
